description: ignorePaths overrides config:recommended's :ignoreModulesAndTests, which ignores **/examples/** — an example plugin's dependencies get update PRs like any other manifest here

packageRules.description: The host's own runtime deps. Release-Bump is opt-in per surface (README → CI/CD) because updateType rates the dependency's own jump, not its effect here — unscoped, the bot's self-update bumped the product
The shipped image's base — e2e-tests/Dockerfile is test-only
The production topology — compose.override.yml is dev, e2e-tests/compose.*.yml are test

node is pinned to one version across Dockerfile, dev, E2E and CI, so Renovate moves them in a single branch whose commitBody would otherwise depend on upgrade order — the Dockerfile copy ships, so any node bump is a product change
Ory services share one release train - update kratos, keto and hydra together
Playwright runner and its browser image are version-locked - bump together
